@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Customer.profileId: Links this customer to their profile record, where their name and contact details are kept.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Customer.creditLimit: The most this customer may owe you at one time. Leave it empty or at zero if you do not set limits.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Customer.paymentTerms: How long the customer has to pay, written the way you would say it, for example "Net 30".
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Customer.taxExempt: Turn this on if you do not charge this customer sales tax.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Customer.taxId: The customer's tax or VAT number, kept on file for tax-exempt sales.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Customer.defaultShippingAddress: Where you usually send this customer's goods, so you do not retype it on every order.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Customer.defaultBillingAddress: Where you send this customer's invoices.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Customer.status: Whether this is a current customer, for example active or inactive.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Customer.customerType: The kind of customer, for example an individual or a business.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Customer.notes: Anything worth remembering about this customer.

@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Vendor.profileId: Links this vendor to their profile record, where their name and contact details are kept.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Vendor.leadTimeDays: How many days the vendor usually takes between your order and delivery.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Vendor.minimumOrderAmount: The smallest order the vendor will accept, in the vendor's currency.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Vendor.paymentTerms: How long you have to pay this vendor, written the way you would say it, for example "Net 30".
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Vendor.currency: The currency this vendor bills you in.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Vendor.defaultContactEmail: The email address you normally use to reach this vendor.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Vendor.defaultContactPhone: The phone number you normally use to reach this vendor.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Vendor.status: Whether you still buy from this vendor, for example active or inactive.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Vendor.notes: Anything worth remembering about this vendor.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Vendor.payoutAddresses: Where payments to this vendor should be sent.

@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.status: Where the order stands, for example draft, accepted or completed.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.customerId: The customer this order is for.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.taxAmount: The tax charged on the order.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.totalAmount: What the customer pays in all, tax included.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.currency: The currency of the order's amounts.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.issueDate: The date the order was placed.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.dueDate: The date payment is expected. An order still open after this date counts as overdue.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.expiryDate: The last day the order's price or offer is good for.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.reference: Your own number or note for finding this order later, such as the customer's purchase order number.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.notes: Anything worth remembering about this order.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.terms: The conditions agreed with the customer, such as deposits, delivery or payment conditions.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:Order.channelId: Where the order came from, for example your shop or a marketplace.

@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.status: Where the purchase stands, for example draft, accepted or completed.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.vendorId: The vendor you are buying from.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.taxAmount: The tax charged on the order.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.totalAmount: What you pay in all, tax included.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.currency: The currency of the order's amounts.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.issueDate: The date you placed the order.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.dueDate: The date the goods or the payment are due.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.expiryDate: The last day the vendor's offer is good for.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.reference: Your own number or note for finding this order later, such as the vendor's quote number.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.notes: Anything worth remembering about this purchase.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.terms: The conditions agreed with the vendor, such as payment or delivery conditions.
@happyvertical/smrt-commerce:PurchaseOrd.channelId: Where the order was placed, for example a vendor's website or a phone call.
